messages:
laura: quick eod snapshot before I log off — leaving coverage notes and a small risk to watch.
laura: pool 'default-gpu' (nv4) — avg util ~78%, 5m peak 95%. burst headroom: ~2 nodes (20%).
laura: noticed customer Pharos embeddings spike ~3x baseline starting 18:12 UTC, correlates with a campaign. no errors yet but tail latencies ticked up to 230ms for a few mins.
laura: runbook short: if pool >85% sustained for 10m OR tail latency >200ms, enable temporary burst (add 2 nodes) or shift some low-priority jobs to dedicated backfill.
laura: cli to add burst:```
redwoodctl pools scale default-gpu --add-nodes 2 --reason "oncall temporary burst"
```
laura: also console path: Console > Capacity > default-gpu > Actions > Add nodes (choose burst).
oncall-bot: Reminder: quota alert configured at 90% for default-gpu pool. See alert: https://console/redwood/alerts/AG-923
sam: I can take 18:00-19:00 UTC handover. will watch in 5m windows and toggle if needed. @laura any preference on prefilling burst or wait until threshold?
jess: prefer wait until we cross 85% and latency condition, unless Pharos confirms longer sustained traffic. burst has slight cold-start hit for other tenants.
sam: got it — will wait for thresholds, but I can pre-warm one node if we hit 88% for 3m.
laura: thanks. if you trigger burst, plz add a note with reason and remove nodes when 5m avg <60%.
sam: noted. I'll also post a quick update in #support if customers ask.
laura: last thing — quick health check command if you want numbers:```bash
redwoodctl metrics tail --pool default-gpu --last 15m --fields util,tail_latency,queued
```
sam: copied commands. I'll ping here at 18:30 or earlier if I scale. enjoy dinner, laura :pizza:
laura: thanks! logging off now — handed to sam. :wave:
